- When sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) over recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly.
- When sentiment is negative (≤0.33) or mixed, model often underestimates; increase forecast to align with downward momentum.
- After sharp price spikes (e.g., +5%+ in 3–5 days), model frequently overshoots; cap forecast at +3–4% above peak or adjust downward 1–2 days post-spike.
- Model shows persistent lag in capturing mean reversion; if price deviates >3σ from 10-day moving average, adjust forecast toward historical mean.
- For 30-day horizon, model tends to overreact to short-term sentiment shifts; smooth out forecast by averaging last 5–7 days’ sentiment-weighted price.
- If sentiment history shows alternating bullish/bearish cycles, model often misaligns with cycle phase; match forecast to dominant sentiment trend over 3–5 days.
